title: Enlightening Activity Class 1
speaker: Kanho Chris Burkhart
summary: Kanho Chris Burkhart takes up Samantabhadra, the bodhisattva of great activity, by asking how practice looks once the sitting stops. After a round of introductions, Kanho describes a default pattern of urgency and narrowing focus, like a hamster on a wheel, and reads Cheri Huber's "A Project for Saving the World." The class offers its own images of transformation, and Kanho adds horse manure turned into compost. Kanho places Samantabhadra as Manjushri's wisdom and Avalokiteshvara's compassion expressed in action, then hands out gathas from the Avatamsaka Sutra and Robert Aitken's The Dragon Who Never Sleeps. The week's assignment is to cut the gathas out, post them around the house, and journal on body sensation and self-talk.
